entities.summary: Ruth Schweikert was a Swiss writer. She is best known for her novels Augen zu (1998), Ohio (2005) and How we get older (2015). Schweikert was awarded a number of prizes, including the Swiss Schiller Foundation Prize in 1999, the Art Prize of the City of Zurich in 2016 and the Solothurn Literature Prize, also in 2016.
